title: DG Khan Cement’s sales rise in 2026 financial year
summary: DG Khan Cement’s sales rise in 2026 financial year
body_markdown: **Pakistan:** DG Khan Cement recorded sales of US$316m in Pakistan’s 2026 financial year, which ended on 30 June 2026. This corresponds to a rise of 11% year-on-year. Cost of sales also rose by 11%, to US$234m. The company successfully grew its profit for the year by 25%, to US$44m.
